items.label: All-weather Bar Stool Set
items.value: 2-piece Adirondack Bar Chairs (24.4"W x 24.4"D x 45.6"H) with 350 lbs weight capacity per chair; 1 piece Adirondack Bar Table(60.24"W x 19.68"D x 40.94"H) with 220 lbs weight capacity. Perfectly matched heights provide a wide view and a comfortable seating experience.

items.label: Sturdy and Durable
items.value: Serwall outdoor furniture crafted from recyclable HDPE (High-Density Polyethylene), this material is built to withstand extreme weather conditions, including intense sun, freezing temperatures, strong winds, and heavy rain, all while maintaining its original color.

items.label: Maintenance-Free
items.value: The Serwall outdoor bar set is engineered for effortless upkeep. It's waterproof and fade-resistant, eliminating the need for painting, staining, or waterproofing. Cleaning is simple—just use soap, water, and a soft bristle brush or sanding sponge.

items.label: Effortless Assembly
items.value: This outdoor bar table and chairs set is easy to assemble, with 80% of the components pre-assembled and 100% pre-drilled. It comes with clear instructions and all necessary tools, allowing you to complete the assembly without extra tools. Save time and enjoy a hassle-free setup experience.

items.label: Umbrella Hole for Easy Outdoor Shade
items.value: The 1.6-inch umbrella hole at the center of the outdoor bar table fits most umbrellas, providing quick sun protection for your outdoor space. A matching plug keeps the table sleek when not in use.

items.label: Waterproof & Quick-Drying
items.value: Our high top patio table and chairs are made from waterproof High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE), and the slatted design allows rainwater to drain quickly, ensuring the surface dries rapidly after a downpour. This makes them an ideal choice for outdoor poolside use.

items.label: Wood-Grain Texture
items.value: Inspired by nature, this outdoor bar table set features a wood-grain design that beautifully blends rustic charm with modern style. It's the perfect addition to any outdoor space, including patios, gardens, poolside, and terraces.

items.label: Space-Saving Design
items.value: When not in use, the bar height table allows the outdoor bar chairs to be neatly tucked underneath, making it the perfect space-saving solution for small areas.

items.label: Built-in Footrest
items.value: The bar height table and bar height stools features integrated footrest, providing a comfortable place to rest your feet while enhancing your overall seating experience.

items.label: Versatile Applications
items.value: This patio bar set elevates the look of any outdoor space with its sleek and modern aesthetic. It's perfect for creating an inviting atmosphere at parties, barbecues, and outdoor gatherings, adding a touch of sophistication to both casual and upscale settings.
